nodes.label: backend service
nodes.rationale: Loopback-only port bind; read_only FS, /tmp tmpfs, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, 256m/1 cpu; healthcheck on /api/health.

nodes.label: COLLECTOR_KEY env var
nodes.rationale: 32+ chars; required for the complete action when DEMO_MODE is off.

nodes.label: DEMO_MODE env var
nodes.rationale: Off unless set; enables /docs and citizen-side simulate delivery.

nodes.label: edge service (Caddy reverse proxy)
nodes.rationale: Public entry; Caddy replaces any client X-Forwarded-For so the backend rate limit is per client, not one shared bucket. Needs NET_BIND_SERVICE because the caddy binary carries that file capability.

nodes.label: frontend service
nodes.rationale: No published port so clients reach Next only through edge and cannot forge X-Forwarded-For; built with BACKEND_URL=http://backend:8000.

nodes.label: PARTNER_KEY env var
nodes.rationale: 32+ chars; partners send it to spend a reward code.

nodes.label: sabz-data volume
nodes.rationale: Holds the SQLite DB at /data; volumes created by the old root image need a one-time chown to uid 10001.

nodes.label: TRUST_PROXY env var
nodes.rationale: Set to 1 so rate limits key on the X-Forwarded-For that edge sets.

nodes.label: SabzBank (سبزبانک)
nodes.rationale: Citizens hand in separated dry waste, earn points and spend them with partners; the municipality gets a live dashboard.

nodes.label: Simulate delivery (demo collector stand-in)
nodes.rationale: Demo-mode-only button that stands in for the collector app: weighs bags with ±10% noise and credits points.

nodes.label: Single demo user with seeded history
nodes.norm_label: single demo user with seeded history

nodes.label: Apple fluid-interface UI/UX pass
nodes.rationale: Critically damped press feedback, overshoot only for success; no glass on glass; reduced transparency/contrast handling; accessible live regions and tabs.

nodes.label: B1 No authentication
nodes.rationale: Partly fixed: DEMO_MODE off unless set; collector action needs X-Collector-Key (32+ chars, constant-time). Real user sign-in deferred as a product decision.

nodes.label: B10 No request body size limit
nodes.norm_label: b10 no request body size limit
nodes.rationale: Pure-ASGI middleware returns 413 above 16 KiB by Content-Length or streamed byte count.

nodes.label: B11 Latent CSRF on bodyless POSTs
nodes.norm_label: b11 latent csrf on bodyless posts
nodes.rationale: POSTs require application/json; Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site gets 403.

nodes.label: B13 Whitespace-only address passes validation
nodes.rationale: Address stripped before validation.

nodes.label: B14 Mission double-submit 500
nodes.rationale: INSERT OR IGNORE plus rowcount returns 409.

nodes.label: B15 No security logging; server banner
nodes.norm_label: b15 no security logging; server banner
nodes.rationale: Request id header and one log line per request; 403/409/413/415/429 at WARNING, 5xx at ERROR; uvicorn --no-server-header.

nodes.label: B16 UTC vs Tehran day
nodes.rationale: Fixed UTC+03:30 offset instead of a zone database; Iran has had no DST since 2022.

nodes.label: B2 Citizen self-crediting via collector complete
nodes.norm_label: b2 citizen self-crediting via collector complete
nodes.rationale: Collector gate plus at most 5 pickups/day counted under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; 8 parallel creates give exactly 5 successes.

nodes.label: B3 Redeem race (TOCTOU overspend)
nodes.rationale: One INSERT…SELECT…WHERE SUM(points) >= cost statement; rowcount decides; balance never goes negative.

nodes.label: B4 Complete race double award
nodes.rationale: UPDATE … WHERE id=? AND status='scheduled' plus rowcount; same for cancel.

nodes.label: B5 No rate limit
nodes.rationale: In-process token bucket, burst 10 then 30/min, on every POST and the code lookup; 429 with Retry-After.

nodes.label: B6 Unbounded GET /api/pickups
nodes.rationale: limit 1..200 (default 50) plus a bounded keyset before cursor; cursor kept despite simplicity review so rows past 200 stay reachable.

nodes.label: B7 Mission answer key leak
nodes.rationale: Answer returned only after a correct answer.

nodes.label: B8 Weak unverifiable reward codes
nodes.rationale: SABZ- plus 72-bit token_urlsafe(9), stored in the same transaction as the debit; GET /api/codes/{code} for partners.

nodes.label: B9 Public API docs and backend port
nodes.norm_label: b9 public api docs and backend port
nodes.rationale: Docs only in demo mode; compose binds the API to 127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: CPU-time benchmark on 10k pickups and transactions
nodes.norm_label: cpu-time benchmark on 10k pickups and transactions
nodes.rationale: Wall-clock numbers were dominated by load average 85-136 on 4 cores, so process CPU time is the fair comparison.

nodes.label: F1 Missing security headers
nodes.rationale: Static headers in next.config.ts, poweredByHeader false, per-request nonce CSP in proxy.ts, HSTS only over HTTPS.

nodes.label: F2 422 errors show [object Object]
nodes.rationale: Errors carry HTTP status; pages map it to localized messages.

nodes.label: F3 Unhandled promise rejections and silent failures
nodes.norm_label: f3 unhandled promise rejections and silent failures
nodes.rationale: Inline localized error states; busy guard against double-clicks on quiz answers.

nodes.label: F4 lang cookie lacks Secure
nodes.rationale: ';secure' over HTTPS.

nodes.label: FP1 Blur on every card over animated blobs
nodes.norm_label: fp1 blur on every card over animated blobs
nodes.rationale: Blur only on navigation chrome and sheets; animations stop on low-power devices and under reduced motion.

nodes.label: FP2 Counters re-render React every frame
nodes.norm_label: fp2 counters re-render react every frame
nodes.rationale: Counters write text through a ref inside the animation frame.

nodes.label: FP3 Client data waterfall after hydration
nodes.norm_label: fp3 client data waterfall after hydration
nodes.rationale: Stale-while-revalidate GET cache cleared by a refresh after any change.

nodes.label: FP4 Fonts via CSS packages without preload
nodes.norm_label: fp4 fonts via css packages without preload
nodes.rationale: next/font/local with preload and size-adjusted fallbacks; unused font packages removed.

nodes.label: I1 Backend container runs as root
nodes.norm_label: i1 backend container runs as root
nodes.rationale: Non-root user sabz (uid 10001); compose adds read_only, /tmp tmpfs, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, memory and CPU limits.

nodes.label: I3 Base images not pinned by digest
nodes.norm_label: i3 base images not pinned by digest
nodes.rationale: Partly fixed: tags pinned; digests left as a comment because they could not be verified.

nodes.label: Interruptible spring bottom sheet
nodes.rationale: 1:1 drag, flick velocity projection, critically damped after slow release and bouncy only after a flick; kept despite simplicity review because Apple-style springs were requested.

nodes.label: N1 Spoofable X-Forwarded-For rate-limit key
nodes.rationale: Backend keys on the rightmost XFF entry; Caddy edge replaces client value; frontend no longer publishes a port.

nodes.label: N10 Log injection via encoded newline
nodes.norm_label: n10 log injection via encoded newline
nodes.rationale: Log lines carry the URL-quoted path.

nodes.label: N11 IPv6 /64 rotation and O(n) bucket sweep
nodes.norm_label: n11 ipv6 /64 rotation and o(n) bucket sweep
nodes.rationale: One bucket per IPv6 /64; idle sweep at most every 10 seconds.

nodes.label: N12 Non-ASCII key header crash and weak keys
nodes.norm_label: n12 non-ascii key header crash and weak keys
nodes.rationale: Keys compared as bytes; startup refuses keys shorter than 32 characters.

nodes.label: N13 Next buffers 10 MB before backend limit
nodes.norm_label: n13 next buffers 10 mb before backend limit
nodes.rationale: proxyClientMaxBodySize: 16kb in next.config.ts.

nodes.label: N15 Root-owned legacy data volume
nodes.rationale: One-time chown command next to the volume in compose, pointer in README; untested without a Docker build.

nodes.label: N4 Daily pickup cap counted outside write lock
nodes.norm_label: n4 daily pickup cap counted outside write lock
nodes.rationale: BEGIN IMMEDIATE runs before the count.

nodes.label: N5 DEMO_MODE failed open
nodes.rationale: Default off in both code and compose; README shows DEMO_MODE=1 for demos.

nodes.label: N6 Uvicorn trusted X-Forwarded-For from localhost
nodes.norm_label: n6 uvicorn trusted x-forwarded-for from localhost
nodes.rationale: --no-proxy-headers in the Dockerfile and the documented dev command.

nodes.label: N7 Reward code reusable at partners
nodes.norm_label: n7 reward code reusable at partners
nodes.rationale: POST /api/codes/{code}/use with X-Partner-Key; single-use via UPDATE … WHERE used IS NULL.

nodes.label: N8 One shared rate-limit bucket behind frontend
nodes.norm_label: n8 one shared rate-limit bucket behind frontend
nodes.rationale: Same fix as N1: Caddy edge sets the client address.

nodes.label: N9 Unbounded pagination cursor
nodes.rationale: le=2**63-1 on the cursor.

nodes.label: Per-request nonce CSP (proxy.ts)
nodes.rationale: style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' on purpose: React style attributes and Tailwind cannot be covered by a nonce.

nodes.label: P1 No WAL; database is locked under concurrent writes
nodes.norm_label: p1 no wal; database is locked under concurrent writes
nodes.rationale: WAL journal mode with synchronous=NORMAL.

nodes.label: P2 /api/state full scans
nodes.rationale: One SQL aggregate over json_each plus indexes on pickups(status, day), pickups(day, id), txns(ts, id); 102 ms to 47 ms CPU.

nodes.label: P3 /api/city computes state twice
nodes.rationale: State computed once; 199 ms to 47 ms CPU.

nodes.label: P4 Catalog refetched on every page
nodes.norm_label: p4 catalog refetched on every page
nodes.rationale: Client-side stale-while-revalidate cache.

nodes.label: Simplicity review (ponytail)
nodes.rationale: 15 proposed cuts (~54 lines): 11 applied, 3 overridden, 1 superseded.

nodes.label: In-process token-bucket rate limiter
nodes.rationale: Per process: fine for one instance; use a shared store such as Redis if the API scales out.

nodes.label: Backend regression suite (test_api.py, 55 assertions)
nodes.rationale: Pattern-based SAST cannot see authorization or race bugs, so 8-way concurrency checks back every fix.

nodes.label: Skipped and remaining risks
nodes.rationale: No real user auth, per-process rate limits, Docker images not built, host-local XFF forgery, images not digest-pinned, npm audit unreachable.

nodes.label: Pure-ASGI security pipeline (body limit, guard, request-id logging)
nodes.norm_label: pure-asgi security pipeline (body limit, guard, request-id logging)
nodes.rationale: Rewritten from BaseHTTPMiddleware: ~0.8 ms CPU per request instead of ~1.2 ms.

nodes.label: SabzBank security, performance and UI/UX audit
nodes.norm_label: sabzbank security, performance and ui/ux audit

nodes.label: Row-count-guarded atomic SQL writes
nodes.rationale: Single-statement INSERT…SELECT / UPDATE…WHERE predicates where rowcount decides success, closing check-then-act races.

nodes.label: BEGIN IMMEDIATE write-lock transactions
nodes.rationale: Kept despite the simplicity review because it backs the race fixes at no cost.

nodes.label: Attack-tree threat model (G0-G6)
nodes.rationale: Attacker goal: obtain rewards or disrupt the service without earning points; each leaf names the control that closes it.

nodes.label: Next.js agent rules: not the Next.js you know
nodes.norm_label: next.js agent rules: not the next.js you know
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking API, convention and file-structure changes; read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code and heed deprecations.

nodes.label: App Icon (icon.svg)
nodes.rationale: Next.js app/ file-convention icon, auto-served as favicon; 64x64 rounded-square app mark using an eco/clean-city leaf motif to match the PakShahr recycling theme
